hook: Dense star clusters relax to one density profile whatever their start, simulations show
summary: Monte Carlo simulations with CMC-COSMIC find that clusters of a given mass and binding energy settle into a King profile with W_0=6.8, regardless of initial density. Black hole binaries in the core supply the energy that balances contraction, and the final virial radius is about 7 times the initial. The result comes from simulations, not observed clusters.
title: On the Existence of an Equilibrium Density Profile for Massive Collisional Star Clusters
